mapper.select:
select BOK_DETAIL_ID as id from BOK_DETAIL_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND BOK_DETAIL_ID like '%' || #{search} || '%'
GROUP BY BOK_DETAIL_ID
select count(*) from sys_batchgrp_exec_info info left join SYS_BATCH_GRP_PRDLINK grplink on info.prd_group_seq_no=grplink.group_seq where 1=1 and info.status in('UNR','RUN')
select count(1) from val_interf_actionlog where STATUS in ('00','01')

select BOOKSET_ID booksetId, /* 账套代码 */ BOK_DETAIL_ID bokDetailId, /* 账务明细代码 */ BUSI_ID busiId, /* 业务明细代码 */ BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE busiDetailType, /* 业务明细类型*/ INV_AIM invAim, /* 投资目的 */ SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, /* 证券管理户代码 */ DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO_TAIL detailSubjectNoTail, /* 四级科目尾号 */ DETAIL_SUBNAME_TAIL detailSubnameTail, /* 四级科目尾号名称 */ BRANCH branch, /* 分支序列 */ CCY ccy /* 币种 */ from BOK_DETAIL_ID
WHERE 1 = 1
AND BOOKSET_ID in

and INV_AIM in
#{item}

#{item}
